title: TikTok Privacy Policy (rest of world)
selection_rationale: TikTok is item 1 of 59 applications blocked by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology on 29 June 2020 under section 69A of the Information Technology Act, 2000. It is retained as a comparison case for a service that does not lawfully operate in India.

blocking_order.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

scope_note: The captured policy is the rest-of-world version, not an India version, because the service is blocked in India. Any comparison must account for this difference in scope.
